description: This file contains code for loading and visualizing a birth names dataset in Apache Superset, including functions for data loading, metadata setup, slice creation, and dashboard assembly.

methods.name: gen_filter
methods.description: Creates a filter dictionary for SQL queries with specified subject, comparator, and operator.

methods.name: load_data
methods.description: Loads example birth names data into a specified database table, with optional sampling.

methods.name: load_birth_names
methods.description: Main function to load the birth names dataset, create associated slices and dashboard.

methods.name: _set_table_metadata
methods.description: Sets metadata fields for a datasource object.

methods.name: _add_table_metrics
methods.description: Adds metrics and timestamp column to the datasource if not already present.

methods.name: create_slices
methods.description: Creates various visualization slices for the birth names dataset.

methods.name: create_dashboard
methods.description: Creates or updates a dashboard with the specified slices.
